blocks.text: will — kelajak haqida fikr va taxmin

**will + fe'l** shakllari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 27–28-darslar), 21-darsda esa will ning «hozir qabul qilingan qaror, taklif, va'da» ma'nosini ko'rdik. Bu darsda — will ning ikkinchi asosiy vazifasi: kelajak haqida **o'zimiz o'ylagan, kutgan yoki ishongan** narsani aytish. Bu yerda gap reja yoki qaror haqida emas, **bashorat** haqida: kelajakni bilmaymiz, lekin fikr bildiramiz. O'zbekchada bunga oddiy kelasi zamon («-adi»), «bo'ladi», ishonch kamroq bo'lsa — «-sa kerak» to'g'ri keladi: You**'ll like** Khiva — Xiva sizga **yoqadi**.

items.text: The film is very long, so we**'ll be** home after midnight.
items.translation: Film juda uzun, shuning uchun uyga yarim tundan keyin **qaytamiz**.

items.text: Kate **won't believe** this story — it sounds crazy.
items.translation: Keyt bu hikoyaga **ishonmaydi** — juda g'alati eshitiladi.

items.text: Next year our company **will be** twenty years old.

blocks.text: Ishonch darajasi: I'm sure, I think, probably, I doubt

Inglizlar bashoratni kamdan-kam «yalang'och» will bilan aytadi: odatda ishonch darajasini ko'rsatadigan so'z qo'shiladi. Bu so'zlar o'zbekchadagi «aminman», «menimcha», «ehtimol», «shubham bor» ga to'g'ri keladi. Ularning hammasidan keyin oddiy **will + fe'l** keladi, `that` esa ko'pincha tushib qoladi: I think (that) it**'ll** rain. Quyidagi jadval — eng ishonchlidan eng shubhaligacha.

rows: I bet he**'ll be** late again.

items.text: **I'm certain** the new bridge **will help** with the traffic in the centre.
items.translation: Yangi ko'prik markazdagi tirbandlikni kamaytirishga **yordam berishiga aminman**.

items.text: **I bet** Tom **will forget** his passport again.
**I wonder** if the train **will be** on time today.

blocks.text: **probably**, **definitely**, **certainly** ravishlari darak gapda **will dan keyin** turadi: She**'ll probably** be late. Inkorda esa **won't dan oldin**: She **probably won't** be late. O'zbekchada «ehtimol» gapning istalgan joyida kelaveradi, shuning uchun «She won't probably come» degan xato ko'p uchraydi. Qoida oson: ravish will dan **keyin**, lekin inkor so'zidan **oldin**.
I don't think ... will — «I think ... won't» o'rniga

Salbiy bashoratda inglizlar inkorni **think** ga qo'yadi: **I don't think** it**'ll** rain. «I think it won't rain» xato emas, lekin kamroq tabiiy eshitiladi. O'zbekchada esa aksincha — inkor fe'lda: «Menimcha, yomg'ir yog'maydi». **expect** bilan ham shunday: **I don't expect** he'll call. Savolda **Do you think ... will ...?** tuzilmasi ishlatiladi: Do you think it'll snow? — «Will you think...?» deyilmaydi.

items.text: **I don't think** Madina **will come** — she's got a bad cold.
**Do you think** the exam **will be** difficult?
What **do you think will happen** next?

blocks.text: Eng muhim chegara: will — **fikr** va hozir qilingan qaror uchun. Agar ish oldindan rejalashtirilgan, kelishilgan, chipta olingan bo'lsa — Present Continuous (→ 19-dars) yoki going to (→ 20-dars) ishlatiladi. «Ertaga Aziz bilan uchrashaman» (allaqachon kelishilgan) — **I'm meeting** Aziz tomorrow, «I will meet» emas. Lekin bir gapda ikkalasi kelishi mumkin: reja — be -ing, rejaning natijasi haqidagi taxmin — will. will va going to farqi batafsil — 23-darsda.

rows: I**'m flying** to Oxford on Monday.

blocks.text: Yangiliklar va rasmiy e'lonlarda oldindan belgilangan voqealar haqida ham **will** ishlatiladi: The President **will visit** Bukhara next week. Bu — rasmiy, axborot uslubi. Kundalik nutqda o'z rejangiz haqida be -ing yoki going to tanlang.
shall — I va we bilan (rasmiy uslub)

Britaniya ingliz tilida **I shall** / **we shall** = I will / we will. Bugun bu rasmiy, biroz eskicha uslub: nutqlarda, rasmiy xatlarda, keksa avlod tilida. Inkori — **shall not** → **shan't**: I **shan't** be long — Ko'p ushlanib qolmayman. he / she / they bilan shall kelajak ma'nosida ishlatilmaydi. Savoldagi **Shall I ...? / Shall we ...?** (taklif, maslahat so'rash) — boshqa ma'no, u 21-darsda o'tilgan. Amerika ingliz tilida shall deyarli uchramaydi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I will meet Aziz tomorrow» (uchrashuv allaqachon kelishilgan) → **I'm meeting** Aziz tomorrow; «She won't probably come» → She **probably won't** come; «I think it won't rain» → **I don't think** it'll rain (tabiiyroq); «Will you think he'll come?» → **Do you think** he'll come?; «Ertaga yomg'ir yog'sa kerak» ni «It must rain tomorrow» deb tarjima qilish — kelajak haqidagi «-sa kerak» = **It'll probably rain** (must — hozirgi xulosa uchun, → 28-dars).

O'zingizga savol bering: «Bu haqda allaqachon kelishilganmi, reja tuzilganmi?» Ha → be -ing / going to. Yo'q, shunchaki fikrim → will. Ishonch darajasini doim bitta so'z bilan ko'rsating: I'm sure / I think / probably / I doubt — shunda nutqingiz ancha tabiiy eshitiladi.

rows: I'm sure / I think / I doubt + **will**

examples.title: Predictions: **will** and **won't**
examples.description: Kelajak haqida fikr va taxmin — reja emas, bashorat. O'zbekchada oddiy kelasi zamon: «-adi», «-maydi».

sentences.text: Don't worry about the exam — you**'ll pass** easily this time.
sentences.translation: Imtihondan xavotir olma — bu safar bemalol **o'tasan**.

sentences.text: Take an umbrella, because the forecast says it**'ll rain** after lunch.
sentences.translation: Soyabon ol, ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra tushlikdan keyin yomg'ir **yog'adi**.

sentences.text: Emma **won't recognise** you with that beard!
sentences.translation: Bu soqol bilan Emma seni **tanimaydi**!

sentences.text: The new metro line **will make** life much easier for people in the suburbs.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro liniyasi chekka hududlardagi odamlarning hayotini ancha **osonlashtiradi**.

sentences.text: Ask Jasur to help you; he **will know** what to do with the printer.
sentences.translation: Jasurdan yordam so'ra, printerni nima qilishni u **biladi**.

sentences.text: Prices **won't go** down this year, so we should buy the flat now.
sentences.translation: Bu yil narxlar **tushmaydi**, shuning uchun kvartirani hozir sotib olishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: Sarah has trained for months, and she**'ll do** brilliantly in the marathon.
sentences.translation: Sara oylab mashq qildi, marafonda zo'r **natija ko'rsatadi**.

sentences.text: In twenty years most cars on our roads **will be** electric.
sentences.translation: Yigirma yildan keyin yo'llarimizdagi mashinalarning aksariyati elektr **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Without regular water, these young trees **won't survive** the hot summer in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Muntazam sug'orilmasa, bu yosh daraxtlar Buxoroning issiq yozidan **omon chiqmaydi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **will notice** the small mark on your shirt, so stop worrying about it.
sentences.translation: Ko'ylagingizdagi kichik dog'ni hech kim **sezmaydi**, shuning uchun xavotir olishni bas qiling.

examples.title: **I think** / **I don't think** ... **will**
examples.description: Fikr bildirish: think + will. Salbiy fikrda inkor think ga qo'yiladi — **I don't think** ... will.

sentences.text: **I think** Madina **will get** the job — she was the strongest candidate.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, ishni Madina **oladi** — u eng kuchli nomzod edi.

sentences.text: **I don't think** the shops **will be** open on New Year's Day.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, Yangi yil kuni do'konlar ochiq **bo'lmaydi**.

sentences.text: Tom **doesn't think** his team **will win** the cup this season.
sentences.translation: Tom jamoasi bu mavsum kubokni **yutadi deb o'ylamaydi**.

sentences.text: Most economists **think** that prices **will rise** again next spring.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik iqtisodchilar kelasi bahorda narxlar yana **oshadi deb hisoblaydi**.

sentences.text: Honestly, **I don't think** James **will lend** us his car again after the accident.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, avariyadan keyin Jeyms bizga mashinasini yana **beradi deb o'ylamayman**.

sentences.text: My parents **think** I**'ll be** happier in Tashkent than in a small town.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam men Toshkentda kichik shaharchadagidan ko'ra baxtliroq **bo'laman deb o'ylashadi**.

sentences.text: We **don't think** the new manager **will change** much in the office.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer ofisda ko'p narsani **o'zgartiradi deb o'ylamaymiz**.

sentences.text: **I think** you**'ll enjoy** this film; it's funny and quite clever.
sentences.translation: **Menimcha**, bu film sizga **yoqadi**: ham kulgili, ham ancha aqlli.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **doesn't think** her brother **will remember** her birthday, but she hopes he will.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza akasi tug'ilgan kunini **eslaydi deb o'ylamaydi**, lekin eslashiga umid qiladi.

sentences.text: Since the roads are icy, **I don't think** many people **will come** to the concert tonight.
sentences.translation: Yo'llar muz bo'lgani uchun bugun kechqurun konsertga ko'p odam **keladi deb o'ylamayman**.

examples.title: How sure? **probably**, **I'm sure**, **I bet**, **I doubt**
examples.description: Ishonch darajasini ko'rsatadigan so'zlar: I'm sure, I expect, I bet, I doubt, I wonder; probably va definitely ning will bilan tartibi.

sentences.text: **I'm sure** you**'ll find** a better job soon — you're very talented.
sentences.translation: Tez orada yaxshiroq ish **topishingizga aminman** — siz juda iqtidorlisiz.

sentences.text: Aziz **will probably be** late, because he's coming from the other side of the city.
sentences.translation: Aziz **kechiksa kerak**, chunki u shaharning narigi chetidan kelyapti.

sentences.text: The weather **probably won't improve** before the weekend.
sentences.translation: Hafta oxirigacha ob-havo **yaxshilanmasa kerak**.

sentences.text: **I expect** the tickets for the final **will sell out** in a few hours.
sentences.translation: Finalga chiptalar bir necha soatda **sotilib tugaydi, deb kutaman**.

sentences.text: **I bet** Kate **will be** the first to finish the test — she always is.
sentences.translation: **Garov o'ynayman**, testni birinchi bo'lib Keyt **tugatadi** — u doim shunaqa.

sentences.text: Bekzod **will definitely call** you back after his meeting with the director.
sentences.translation: Bekzod direktor bilan uchrashuvdan keyin sizga **albatta qayta qo'ng'iroq qiladi**.

sentences.text: Frankly, **I doubt** the builders **will finish** the repairs by Friday.
sentences.translation: Ochig'i, quruvchilar ta'mirni juma kunigacha **tugatishiga shubham bor**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **wonders** whether her new laptop **will be** worth the money.
sentences.translation: Nilufar yangi noutbuki shuncha pulga **arzirmikan, deb o'ylayapti**.

sentences.text: There's heavy traffic on the ring road, so the taxi **will almost certainly be** late.
sentences.translation: Halqa yo'lda tirbandlik katta, shuning uchun taksi **deyarli aniq kechikadi**.

sentences.text: Don't lend Oliver any more money, because he **probably won't pay** you back.
sentences.translation: Oliverga boshqa qarz berma, chunki u pulni **qaytarmasa kerak**.

examples.title: Questions: **Will** ...? **Do you think** ... **will**?
examples.description: Kelajak haqida savol: Will ...?, When will ...? va fikr so'rash — **Do you think** ... will ...? Savol → javob juftliklari.

sentences.text: **Will** the shops **be** open on Sunday? — Yes, but only until four.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni do'konlar ochiq **bo'ladimi**? — Ha, lekin faqat soat to'rtgacha.

sentences.text: When **will** you **know** the results of your blood test?
sentences.translation: Qon tahlilingiz natijalarini qachon **bilasiz**?

sentences.text: **Do you think** Oliver **will like** the watch we bought him?
sentences.translation: Oliverga biz olgan soat **yoqadi deb o'ylaysanmi**?

sentences.text: How long **will** the journey to Samarkand **take** on the fast train?
sentences.translation: Tezyurar poyezdda Samarqandgacha yo'l qancha **vaqt oladi**?

sentences.text: **Will** you **be** at home this evening? I want to drop off your book.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun uyda **bo'lasizmi**? Kitobingizni olib kelib bermoqchiman.

sentences.text: **Do you think** it**'ll snow** in Tashkent this winter? — I doubt it.
sentences.translation: Bu qish Toshkentda qor **yog'adi deb o'ylaysizmi**? — Shubham bor.

sentences.text: What time **will** the guests **arrive**, and how many of them **will** there **be**?
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar soat nechada **keladi** va ular necha kishi **bo'ladi**?

sentences.text: Where **do you think** people **will spend** their holidays in fifty years' time?
sentences.translation: Ellik yildan keyin odamlar ta'tilni qayerda **o'tkazadi deb o'ylaysiz**?

sentences.text: **Will** Nilufar **mind** if I bring a friend to her party? — No, she**'ll be** glad.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning ziyofatiga do'stimni olib borsam, u **qarshi bo'lmaydimi**? — Yo'q, **xursand bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Who **do you think will win** the election, and **will** it **change** anything?
sentences.translation: Saylovda kim **yutadi deb o'ylaysiz** va bu biror narsani **o'zgartiradimi**?

examples.title: Already arranged? Not **will**
examples.description: Kelishilgan reja — Present Continuous, going to yoki jadval (Present Simple); will esa shu reja haqidagi taxmin uchun. Ko'p gapda ikkalasi yonma-yon.

sentences.text: **We're flying** to London on Monday, and I'm sure the children **will love** it.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni Londonga **uchyapmiz**, bolalarga albatta **yoqadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **is starting** his new job next week, so he **won't have** much free time.
sentences.translation: Jasur kelasi hafta yangi ishini **boshlayapti**, shuning uchun bo'sh vaqti ko'p **bo'lmaydi**.

sentences.text: I can't come on Friday because **I'm meeting** a client, but I**'ll probably be** free on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni kela olmayman, chunki mijoz bilan **uchrashaman**, lekin shanba kuni **bo'sh bo'lsam kerak**.

sentences.text: My sister **is getting** married in June, and the wedding **will be** huge.
sentences.translation: Opam iyunda turmushga **chiqyapti**, to'y juda katta **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: We**'ve booked** a table for eight people, so there **will be** plenty of room.
sentences.translation: Sakkiz kishilik stol **band qildik**, shuning uchun joy yetarli **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Emma **is going to sell** her car, but I doubt anyone **will pay** that price.
sentences.translation: Emma mashinasini **sotmoqchi**, lekin kimdir shu narxni **to'lashiga shubham bor**.

sentences.text: The conference **starts** at nine tomorrow, and it **will** probably **last** all day.
sentences.translation: Konferensiya ertaga soat to'qqizda **boshlanadi** va **kun bo'yi davom etsa kerak**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **doing** anything tonight? — Yes, **I'm seeing** a film with Kate.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun biror ish **qilyapsanmi**? — Ha, Keyt bilan kinoga **boryapman**.

sentences.text: Oliver **has decided** to study in Edinburgh, and I think he**'ll find** the winters hard.
sentences.translation: Oliver Edinburgda o'qishga **qaror qildi**, menimcha, u yerning qishi unga **og'ir keladi**.

sentences.text: The government **is opening** a new hospital next year, which **will create** hundreds of jobs.
sentences.translation: Hukumat kelasi yili yangi shifoxona **ochyapti**, u yuzlab ish o'rinlari **yaratadi**.

examples.title: Formal **shall**: **I shall**, **we shall**, **shan't**
examples.description: I va we bilan **shall** = will, lekin rasmiyroq va biroz eskicha: nutq, rasmiy xat. Inkori — **shan't**.

sentences.text: **We shall announce** the winners of the competition at the end of the evening.
sentences.translation: Tanlov g'oliblarini kechaning oxirida **e'lon qilamiz**.

sentences.text: **I shall be** very grateful for any advice you can give me.
sentences.translation: Bera oladigan har qanday maslahatingiz uchun juda **minnatdor bo'laman**.

sentences.text: **I shan't be** long — I just need to pick up some bread.
sentences.translation: **Ko'p ushlanib qolmayman** — faqat non olib kelishim kerak.

sentences.text: **We shall see** what the doctor says before we make any plans.
sentences.translation: Biror reja tuzishdan oldin shifokor nima deyishini **ko'ramiz**.

sentences.text: In my speech **I shall talk** about three problems facing our city.
sentences.translation: Nutqimda shahrimiz oldida turgan uchta muammo haqida **gapiraman**.

sentences.text: Without your support, we **shall** never **finish** this project on time.
sentences.translation: Sizning yordamingizsiz bu loyihani hech qachon o'z vaqtida **tugatmaymiz**.

sentences.text: **We shan't need** the car tomorrow, so you can borrow it.
sentences.translation: Ertaga mashina bizga **kerak bo'lmaydi**, olib tursang bo'ladi.

sentences.text: I promise that **I shall** never **forget** your kindness to my family.
sentences.translation: Va'da beraman, oilamga qilgan yaxshiligingizni hech qachon **unutmayman**.

sentences.text: In everyday speech most British people say **I'll** rather than **I shall**.
sentences.translation: Kundalik nutqda ko'pchilik britaniyaliklar **I shall** emas, **I'll** deydi.

sentences.text: If the weather stays fine, **we shall spend** the whole day by the lake.
sentences.translation: Agar ob-havo yaxshi tursa, kun bo'yi ko'l bo'yida **o'tkazamiz**.

examples.title: Dialogue: worrying about a move abroad
examples.description: Madina Manchesterga ishga ketmoqchi va xavotirda; do'sti Sara uni will bilan bashoratlar orqali tinchlantiradi.

sentences.text: — I've got the job in Manchester, but I'm scared I **won't like** it there.
sentences.translation: — Manchesterdagi ishga qabul qilindim, lekin u yer menga **yoqmaydi**, deb qo'rqyapman.

sentences.text: — Don't worry, you**'ll love** it — the people are really friendly.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olma, senga juda **yoqadi** — odamlari juda samimiy.

sentences.text: — **Will** I **make** friends quickly, though? I don't know anyone there.
sentences.translation: — Lekin tez do'st **orttiramanmi**? U yerda hech kimni tanimayman.

sentences.text: — Of course you **will**, and I'll visit you as often as I can.
sentences.translation: — Albatta **orttirasan**, men ham imkon qadar tez-tez kelib turaman.

sentences.text: — What about the weather? I'm sure it**'ll rain** every single day.
sentences.translation: — Ob-havo-chi? Har kuni yomg'ir **yog'ishiga aminman**.

sentences.text: — Probably, but you**'ll get** used to it after the first winter.
sentences.translation: — Ehtimol, lekin birinchi qishdan keyin **ko'nikib ketasan**.

sentences.text: — And **do you think** my English **will be** good enough for meetings?
sentences.translation: — Ingliz tilim yig'ilishlar uchun yetarli **bo'ladi, deb o'ylaysanmi**?

sentences.text: — Definitely — in a few months you**'ll sound** like a local.
sentences.translation: — Albatta — bir necha oyda mahalliy odamdek **gapirasan**.

sentences.text: — **I don't think** my mum **will stop** worrying about me, though.
sentences.translation: — Ammo oyim men haqimda xavotir olishni **to'xtatmasa kerak**.

sentences.text: — She **won't**, but she**'ll** soon **see** how happy you are.
sentences.translation: — **To'xtatmaydi**, lekin tez orada qanchalik baxtli ekaningni **ko'radi**.

examples.title: Mixed: news, technology and the future
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: yangiliklar va texnologiya haqidagi bashoratlar, ishonch darajasi, savol va reja bilan farq.

sentences.text: Experts say that by 2040 robots **will do** many of the jobs that people do today.
sentences.translation: Mutaxassislarning aytishicha, 2040-yilga kelib bugun odamlar qilayotgan ko'p ishlarni robotlar **bajaradi**.

sentences.text: According to the forecast, temperatures in Fergana **will reach** forty degrees this week.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra, bu hafta Farg'onada harorat qirq darajaga **yetadi**.

sentences.text: The new app is free, so **I expect** thousands of students **will download** it.
sentences.translation: Yangi ilova bepul, shuning uchun minglab talabalar uni **yuklab olishini kutaman**.

sentences.text: Electric buses **won't solve** the traffic problem, but they**'ll make** the air cleaner.
sentences.translation: Elektr avtobuslar tirbandlik muammosini **hal qilmaydi**, lekin havoni **tozaroq qiladi**.

sentences.text: If the factory closes, many families in the town **will lose** their only income.
sentences.translation: Agar zavod yopilsa, shaharchadagi ko'p oilalar yagona daromadidan **ayriladi**.

sentences.text: **Do you think** people **will** still **read** paper books in fifty years?
sentences.translation: Ellik yildan keyin ham odamlar qog'oz kitob **o'qiydi deb o'ylaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Doctors warn that the flu **will probably spread** quickly once the schools open.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning ogohlantirishicha, maktablar ochilgach gripp **tez tarqalsa kerak**.

sentences.text: **I don't think** the price of petrol **will fall** while the crisis continues.
sentences.translation: Inqiroz davom etar ekan, benzin narxi **tushadi deb o'ylamayman**.

sentences.text: The minister **is visiting** Khiva tomorrow, and journalists are sure he **will talk** about tourism.
sentences.translation: Vazir ertaga Xivaga **tashrif buyuradi**, jurnalistlar u turizm haqida **gapirishiga amin**.

sentences.text: Online lessons **will never** completely **replace** teachers, because students need real contact.
sentences.translation: Onlayn darslar hech qachon o'qituvchilarning o'rnini to'liq **bosmaydi**, chunki talabalarga jonli muloqot kerak.
